heroHeadline: GNU Bans Informal Currency Imports as Rehabilitated Benghazi University Reopens
heroSubtitle: Tripoli's Economy Ministry issued Decision 449/2026 on September 6, banning imports of goods for trade outside official banking channels from September 30 in a bid to curb hard-currency and letters-of-credit fraud amid the dinar's continued slide. Two days earlier, the FDRL under Belgasem Haftar reopened the fully rehabilitated University of Benghazi in a ceremony attended by HoR Speaker Aguila Saleh, GNS PM Osama Hamad, and LNA chief Khalifa Haftar — a reconstruction milestone that preceded the second Libyan-American Development and Reconstruction Forum held in Benghazi on September 5. No new military incidents or oil-infrastructure strikes were confirmed this period.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
